exploit_name: Self-settlement via dispatchFrom bypasses refund mechanism
description: Self-settlement path bypasses standard collateral validation and refund checks applied to third-party settlements.
root_cause: Self-settlement path bypasses standard collateral validation and refund checks applied to third-party settlements.
fix_description: Apply identical validation and refund mechanisms to self-settlement paths.
notes: Users can settle premium obligations while underfunded, creating accounting mismatches.
